questions.stem: Which three are kinds of endorsement in Fabric? Each correct answer is a complete solution.

options.text: Archived
Certified
Promoted
Encrypted
Master data

questions.explanation: Items can be endorsed as Promoted, Certified or Master data.

questions.stem: Who can mark an item as Certified?

options.text: Only the item's creator
Anyone with a Pro license
Anyone who can view the item
Users a Fabric administrator has authorized to certify

questions.explanation: Certification is controlled: Fabric admins choose who can certify. Promotion is open to people with write permission on the item.

questions.stem: What does a Master data endorsement tell people about an item?

options.text: It holds core, single-source-of-truth data, such as the customer list
It has passed a deployment pipeline
It is the newest item in the workspace
It is encrypted

questions.explanation: Master data marks items whose data is the authoritative source for core business entities.

options.text: To turn on Git integration
To give everyone edit access
So people can find trusted, quality content more easily
To reduce capacity use

questions.explanation: Endorsement badges show which items are trustworthy, and people can find endorsed items in places such as the OneLake catalog.

questions.stem: A Contributor in a workspace wants to mark a lakehouse they built as ready for reuse. No admin has given them any special rights. Which endorsement can they apply?

options.text: Certified
None; endorsement always needs a Fabric admin
Master data
Promoted

questions.explanation: Any user with write permission on an item can promote it. Certified and Master data need users specified by a Fabric admin.

questions.stem: A team wants to certify the most-used Power BI dashboard in the organization. What happens?

options.text: It can be certified like any other item
It can only be promoted
It can be certified only by a domain admin
It can't be promoted or certified, because Power BI dashboards are excluded

questions.explanation: All Fabric and Power BI items can be promoted or certified except Power BI dashboards.

questions.stem: Which item can be labeled as Master data?

options.text: A pipeline that loads the customer list
A Power BI dashboard on customers
A notebook that cleans the customer list
A lakehouse that holds the customer list

questions.explanation: Master data can only be applied to items that contain data, such as lakehouses and semantic models.

questions.stem: Finance and HR want different expert reviewers to certify the items in their own areas. What makes this possible?

options.text: Creating a separate tenant for each department
Delegating certification to domain administrators, so each domain can specify its own reviewers
Giving each reviewer the Admin role on every workspace
Promoting items instead of certifying them

questions.explanation: Certification can be delegated to the domain level, where domain admins specify their own certifiers.

questions.stem: Users see the Promoted option for their items, but the Certified option is unavailable to everyone. What is the likely cause?

options.text: The workspace is on a trial capacity
A Fabric administrator hasn't enabled certification for the organization
The items have no sensitivity label
The items aren't connected to Git

questions.explanation: Certification and Master data are available only after a Fabric administrator enables them. Promotion is always available to people with write permission.

questions.stem: Which two statements about endorsement are true? Each correct answer is a complete solution.

options.text: Only users specified by a Fabric administrator can label items as Master data
Only the item's creator can promote it
Promoting an item copies it to every workspace in the domain
Any user can request certification for an item
An item can carry Promoted and Certified badges at the same time

questions.explanation: Anyone can request certification, but only authorized users certify or label Master data. Promotion is open to anyone with write permission, and an item gets one of the three badges.
